scenarios.description: vollstaendiger LONG Entry → Exit → Roundtrip → Ledger
scenarios.notes: Canonical legacy path opens only on signal==+1; exit on -1 with open long.

scenarios.description: SHORT Entry mapped to -1 does not open; no Roundtrip on legacy path
scenarios.notes: Not a silent fill bug: productive long-only open semantics. Panel #5343 SHORT-heavy enter intents explain zero-trade cohort at this boundary.

scenarios.description: entry_side=NONE fail-closed: no directional cycle, no fill/roundtrip
scenarios.notes: cycle_signal_value=+1 alone does not invent LONG when entry_side=NONE.

scenarios.description: Entry accepted (mapped +1), fill/open rejected by sizing
scenarios.notes: Legitimate fail-closed sizing reject; not a ledger persistence bug.

scenarios.description: Entry-Fill vs Position-Open inseparability on canonical legacy path
scenarios.notes: No distinct Fill object exists on MV2 legacy path; Trade(...) open IS the fill. Scenario 'fill without position' is not reproducible as a productive defect.

scenarios.description: Open position without signal-matched exit (EOD close still completes RT)
scenarios.notes: Unmatched signal-exit does not drop the roundtrip under productive finalize.

scenarios.description: Entry+Exit fills present but Roundtrip missing — not separable on legacy
scenarios.notes: Exit path appends completed Trade immediately; no orphan fill layer exists.

scenarios.description: Roundtrip present; ledger missing only when materializer skipped
scenarios.notes: No engine persistence defect; ledger is a pure materialization consumer.

scenarios.description: Partial Fill / Partial Close on canonical legacy owner
scenarios.notes: Canonical owner models full open/full close only; no partial aggregation path.

scenarios.description: Fees/slippage nonzero with cost application — trade existence preserved
scenarios.notes: Default LEGACY_PATH_COST_APPLICATION=False zeroes costs on productive path; when enabled, economics change but roundtrip/ledger existence remains.
Separate engine invocations; ledger binds instrument_id per call — no cross-match.

scenarios.description: Identical timestamps with stable ledger ordering
scenarios.notes: trade_id uses run_id-trade-{index}; order follows engine append order.
